params.body:
A dealer working in French still read Dutch, English and raw keys on five screens, and Dutch in the notification bell. Everything below is now a translation key in nl, fr, en and de.

## Screens
- **Offres > bidding offers**: the heading was the literal `Biedingsaanbod`; it now uses the existing `bidding.offering`.
- **Relations**: the expanded row ("Op zoek naar", "Voorgestelde wagens", the empty-state line) and the proposal table in the edit modal (Wagen, Datum, Gemaild) use `relation.*` keys. The country showed the stored English name ("Belgium"); `Country::localizedName()` now takes the name from the ISO code in the reader's language (intl), and falls back to the stored name.
- **Settings > Website**: the language label, the language options (the `languages` table only holds Dutch names, so French users read "Frans"; `Enumeration::getLanguageSelectOptions()` now names each language in the viewer's language, which also fixes the language pickers in the offer, order and rental modals), the whole public API block including its confirm and toasts in `layouts/app.blade.php`, the copy buttons, the km/year filter labels and options. The fr/en placeholders (`weboptions`, `Font kleur`, `website_toggle_button_kleur`, `... eng`) are real translations now.
- **Notifications page**: title, subtitle, "mark all read" and the empty state.
- **Vehicle sheet, portals**: `dealer.nederland_mobiel` was `nederland_mobiel fr` / `... eng`. Nederland Mobiel is now called "België/Nederland Mobiel" in all four languages (dealer, menu and vehicle keys, plus the send/remove confirmations). Only lang files changed here; `vehicle-form.blade.php` is untouched.

## Notifications in the recipient's language
The Car-Pass ready, new bid (bidding box and classic bid page) and vehicle sold notifications were stored as Dutch sentences. New `TranslatedNotification` stores translation keys plus placeholders, and `Notify::dealerTranslated()` sends one per user with `->locale()` set to that user's language, else their dealer's, else the app default. The text is resolved when it is stored, so two colleagues with different languages each get their own. Notifications already stored keep their Dutch text.

## Rules and finding
- New R P2-2.16 (these screens, plus country and language names that follow the reader) and R P1-4.8 (notifications in the recipient's language).
- Fixes bevinding franse-schermen-spreken-nederlands.

## Tests
- `FrenchLeftoversTest`: the screen keys exist in all four languages and are not Dutch in French; the Website tab, an expanded relation (with "Belgique"), the bidding offers heading, the notifications page and the portal block render in French. Dutch needles added to the existing list.
- `NotificationsInTheRecipientsLanguageTest`: a Car-Pass fetched by a Dutch user in a Dutch session reaches the French colleague in French and the Dutch one in Dutch; a user without a language gets the dealer's, and a missing vehicle name is translated.
- Checked that both classes fail without the fix. Related suites (922 tests), Rules*, QualityRatchetTest, LanguageParityTest and PHPStan pass locally.
params.title: French screens speak French: bidding offers, relations, website settings, notifications, portal label
